description: Paid ($0.25 USD). Bundle: who an XRPL wallet is and what it has been doing, in one call and one payment. Combines the XR-Sentinel activity scan (with change since the previous scan and narrative), a domain check, XR-Pulse events for the address, a 90-day XR-Ledger statement and the wallet's XR-Trust permissioned-domain role. Returns summary, key_numbers and sections; each section says ok, stale or unreadable. Not charged if the main scan fails.
name: xrpl_wallet_check
